Your Guide to AI-Powered Audience Targeting for New Year's Celebrations and Resolutions


[Download Now](https://www.comscore.com/Request/Guides/2027-New-Years-Guide)


The New Year brings a surge in consumer activity, from planning celebrations and winter travel to pursuing health, wellness, and self-improvement goals.


Proximic's AI-driven contextual, predictive, and AI Prompt Intent audiences help brands connect with high-intent consumers as they research, plan, and make purchasing decisions throughout the season.


Download the guide to explore ready-to-activate audiences and customizable solutions designed to reach consumers across New Year's celebrations, wellness journeys, and resolution-driven moments
